verdict.rationale: Folk documents an official MCP server whose help-center use cases are explicitly natural-language operations from Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and similar assistants. These include finding relationships in plain language, logging calls or meetings by voice, bulk-updating records and importing contacts. The pricing page also lists 'AI Assistants' as a feature. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the NL command scope (the evidence is mostly help-article titles), evidence of a native in-app natural-language command interface beyond a bare 'AI Assistants' mention, independent or hands-on corroboration.
